description: Single filer; one W-2 ($50,000 wages, $4,000 withheld); one 1099-INT (Box 1 $500); one 1099-DIV (Box 1a $1,000, Box 1b $600); one 1099-B (short-term proceeds $8,000 / basis $6,000; long-term proceeds $3,000 / basis $3,500; no adjustments reported). Money values below are integer cents.

_sources.1z: Total income from Form W-2 (only component here); Form 1040 line 1z
_sources.2a: No tax-exempt interest was reported (the only 1099-INT has no Box 8 amount); Form 1040 line 2a; 1099-INT Box 8
_sources.2b: 1099-INT Box 1 = $500, plus $0 entered directly; Form 1040 line 2b
_sources.3b: 1099-DIV Box 1a (total ordinary dividends) = $1,000, plus $0 entered directly; Form 1040 line 3b
_sources.7: Capital gain: Schedule D line 16 = net short-term $2,000 + net long-term -$500 = $1,500 gain, so line 7 is the full $1,500 (the IRC 1211(b) limit applies only to losses); Form 1040 line 7 (via Schedule D)
_sources.schd_net_short: 1099-B short-term: proceeds (Box 1d) $8,000 - basis (Box 1e) $6,000 + adjustment (Box 1g, none reported) $0 = $2,000; Form 8949 Part I -> Schedule D line 7 (internal key)
_sources.schd_net_long: 1099-B long-term: proceeds (Box 1d) $3,000 - basis (Box 1e) $3,500 + adjustment (Box 1g, none reported) $0 = -$500; Form 8949 Part II -> Schedule D line 15 (internal key)
_sources.schd_net_capital_gain: QDCG Worksheet line 3: 'Enter the smaller of line 15 or line 16 of Schedule D. If either line 15 or line 16 is blank or a loss, enter -0-.' Schedule D line 15 here is a $500 loss, so the QDCG capital gain is $0 even though Schedule D line 16 is a $1,500 gain - Qualified Dividends and Capital Gain Tax Worksheet (Instructions for Form 1040, line 16)
_sources.schd_carryover_short: Schedule D line 16 is a gain, not a loss, so there is no capital loss carryover - Capital Loss Carryover Worksheet (Instructions for Schedule D)
_sources.schd_carryover_long: Schedule D line 16 is a gain, not a loss, so there is no capital loss carryover - Capital Loss Carryover Worksheet (Instructions for Schedule D)
_sources.11: AGI = line 9 (no adjustments in this case); Form 1040 line 11
_sources.12: TY2025 standard deduction, single: $15,750 - Rev. Proc. 2024-40 as adjusted by OBBBA (P.L. 119-21); params/2025.json
_sources.16: Qualified Dividends and Capital Gain Tax Worksheet (Instructions for Form 1040, line 16), figured line by line: L1 = taxable income $37,250; L2 = qualified dividends (line 3a) $600; L3 = $0 (Schedule D line 15 is a loss - see schd_net_capital_gain); L4 = $600; L5 = 37250 - 600 = $36,650; L6 = $48,350 zero-rate threshold, single (Rev. Proc. 2024-40, section 3.03); L7 = min(37250, 48350) = $37,250; L8 = min(36650, 37250) = $36,650; L9 = 37250 - 36650 = $600 taxed at 0%; L10 = $600; L12 = 600 - 600 = $0, so the 15% and 20% amounts (L18, L21) are $0; L22 = Tax Table on L5 $36,650 = row 36,650-36,700, single = $4,163 (Publication 1040, Tax Table); L23 = $4,163; L24 = Tax Table on L1 $37,250 = $4,235; L25 = smaller of L23/L24 = $4,163.00. Supersedes the v1 bracket figure of $4,231.50 (which taxed the $600 of qualified dividends at ordinary rates).
_sources.line16_method: qdcg - qualified dividends were reported on line 3a, so the QDCG Worksheet is the prescribed method (Instructions for Form 1040, line 16)
_sources.25d: W-2 Box 2 $4,000 + 1099-INT Box 4 $0 + 1099-DIV Box 4 $0 + 1099-B Box 4 $0; Form 1040 line 25d
_sources.33: Line 33 = line 25d in v1 (withholding only, no refundable credits); Form 1040 line 33
_sources.34: No overpayment: line 33 ($4,000) does not exceed line 16 ($4,163.00); Form 1040 line 34
_sources.37: Line 16 - line 33 = 4163 - 4000 = $163.00 amount owed; Form 1040 line 37
